seoTitle: USPR Cirillico · Football, basketball and volleyball for Russian speakers in Turin
seoDescription: USPR Cirillico: football, basketball and volleyball in Turin for students, refugees and emigrants from the former USSR. First training free. A ConVoglio OdV project.
subtitle: Russian-Speakers Sports Union
lead: A team against war: here friendship is stronger than any conflict.
heroImageAlt: USPR Cirillico flyers for football, basketball and volleyball
sportsLead: Men's and women's teams. Your first training is free.
discount: Special discounted terms for women, under-18s and students.
whoLead: Young women and men from the former Soviet Union countries who live in Turin. The team is open to anyone who shares our ethical guidelines.

storyTitle: From a neighbourhood tournament to the newspapers.

timeline.text: The group forms to play at Balon Mundial, Turin's tournament of communities.
With the war in Ukraine the team becomes an example of integration, covered by Italian and international media.
Friendly match with ASD San Paolo Torino.
